$$3 + {{x - 11} \over {{{(y - 19)}^2}{{(z - 12)}^2}}} + {{y - 19} \over {{{(x - 11)}^2}{{(z - 12)}^2}}} + {{z - 12} \over {{{(x - 11)}^2}{{(y - 19)}^2}}} - {{x + y + z} \over {14(x - 11)(y - 19)(z - 12)}}$$ is equal to :
